facts.fact: PPCC executive director Bodger Scott Johnson said on 2025-09-23 that the e-GP system, launched in February 2025, runs all procurement of six government entities, with 50 more to be onboarded by the next fiscal year.

PPCC executive director Bodger Scott Johnson said contracts worth US$12,219,000 had been awarded through the e-GP system, including 27 by the Liberia Revenue Authority, 19 by Public Works, 17 by PPCC, 10 by Finance and 7 by Education.

LBR.note: Procurement system for government buying, not a service for citizens or businesses to apply for.
Gap in procurement by owner sex, not in internet use.
